name: AI-Fiscal
banner_subtitle: How potential AI futures would play out in the current tax system
detailed_description: Microsimulation of the change in federal revenue and the distribution of post-tax-and-transfer income under shocks to productivity and the capital-labor share. Inputs are calibrated against Karger et al. 2026 (NBER w35046) AI-adoption trajectories; the pipeline routes the implied capital flow across tax units (Smith-Yagan-Zidar pass-through split) and across income types, then runs the Budget Lab Tax-Simulator to produce per-cell revenue and distributional deltas.
policy_area: Tax Microsimulation, AI Macroeconomics, Distributional Analysis
